I been carrying my troubles like a sack of stones
Carrying them down the highway, carrying them home
Carried them to bed at night and woke up with them too
Lord, I'm tired of carrying, don't know what to do

[Chorus]
Casting all your anxiety on him
Because he cares for you
Casting all your anxiety on him

[Verse]
Old fisherman Peter learned it hard and slow
He wrote it in a letter so the rest of us would know
Humble yourselves under God's mighty hand
So that he may lift you up in due time

[Chorus]
Casting all your anxiety on him
Because he cares for you
Casting all your anxiety on him
Because he cares for you

[Bridge]
Set it down, set it down
Lay your heavy burden on the ground
Set it down, set it down
He cares for you

[Outro]
Because he cares for you
Because he cares for you
